prompt: I need to set up a development environment for contributing to a Kubernetes-based microservices architecture using Docker and Helm, running locally on macOS – what’s the most efficient way to achieve this without needing a full VM?
chosen: Docker Desktop. Obviously. Get the latest version – it handles Kubernetes locally fine. Helm’s in there too. You'll probably still run into some weird macOS permission nonsense, though—that part is consistently delightful. Configuration files are your friend; don’t reinvent the wheel if you can help it. Should be up and running in twenty minutes tops. Assuming your machine isn't actively fighting against you. Which, let’s be honest, is a distinct possibility.
